title: [Claude] 上午申请解封，中午已经解封，晚上继续被封
content:
Hello,

We reviewed your account and believe we made a mistake. We’ve restored your access to Claude, and we apologize for the disruption.

If your paid plan on the web was cancelled during the hold, you’ll need to subscribe again to use it. Plans through Google Play may come back when you open the Claude app on your Android device and sign in, so try that before you subscribe again. Plans through Apple may come back on their own.

Open Claude
Regards

Anthropic’s Safeguards Team

上一次对话已是两年前了
author: AtlantaANiu
